title: Add Storybook-independent UI documentation mesh export for Architecture Studio consumption
objective: Implement an Nx-run documentation mesh export in packages/ui so Architecture Studio can consume structured UI documentation data without requiring Storybook.
validations: DONE: .\node_modules\.bin\nx run ui:docs-mesh-export generated docs/generated/meshes/ui-doc-mesh.v1.json successfully.
DONE: rerun of .\node_modules\.bin\nx run ui:docs-mesh-export produced a 100% Nx cache hit, confirming deterministic output.
DONE: no Storybook dependency/config was introduced; export path is plain JSON + Node script + Nx target only.
risks: Mesh schema starts minimal and may need extension as Architecture Studio documentation surfaces evolve.
Source-of-truth remains manually curated JSON for now; automated extraction from TS props is intentionally out of scope.
